episodes.title: Select Bus Service began on the B44
episodes.summary: Select Bus Service started on Nostrand and Rogers Avenues alongside the existing local route, with offset bus lanes, kerbside fare machines and rebuilt boarding islands.

components.label: Bus lane
components.detail: 9.6 miles of bus lanes implemented along the B44 SBS counting both directions of travel, covering just over half of the route. Offset bus lanes on Nostrand Avenue, curbside bus lanes where space was a concern.

components.label: Off-board fare collection
components.detail: Off-board fare collection with MetroCard and coin machines at every bus stop. Roving fare inspectors check tickets on board.

components.label: Bus bulb
components.detail: 15 bus bulbs constructed — eight on Nostrand Avenue and seven on Rogers and Bedford Avenues. All north of Flatbush Avenue. High curb nearly level with bus floor.

components.label: Route change
components.detail: Northbound B44 SBS rerouted from New York Avenue to Rogers Avenue, decreasing northbound route from 9.9 to 9.5 miles. B44 Local maintained on New York Avenue.
